notes: Multi Studio version 2.2.1: **Sentence-Based AI Transcription**: Upgraded AI Scriber to segment transcripts strictly sentence-by-sentence (1 complete sentence per timestamp card). Replaced arbitrary character limit controls with clean sentence boundary grouping for neater, better-organized transcript cards., **Per-Card Manual Cancel Control**: Added a manual cancel/remove button directly onto each audio playlist card, allowing users to cancel or remove individual clips even while they are actively queued or processing., **Unlimited AI Transcription Timeouts**: Removed network timeout limits on AI Transcribe requests to allow long audio recordings and complex AI models to complete transcription without interrupting or timing out early., **Power & Resource Optimization**: Removed continuous CSS spinning and pulse keyframe animations on the Processing Playlist panel, drastically lowering CPU and GPU hardware power consumption during background audio transcription., **Instant Transcription Cancellation**: Fixed the Stop/Cancel button in AI Scriber so clicking Stop immediately halts the active spinner, clears progress messages, and resets processing or queued audio clips back to pending without hanging or freezing., **Natural Khmer & Thai Spacing**: Removed hardcoded continuous-writing rules and forced space-stripping regex when merging transcript segments. AI Scriber now naturally preserves spaces for speech pauses, breath breaks, and reading clause boundaries in Khmer, Thai, Lao, and Burmese scripts., **Tauri Native Drag Reordering Fix**: Resolved drag-and-drop playlist item reordering in Tauri desktop mode by ignoring native Webview drag events when an internal card re-order is active. Audio cards now remain 100% visible with live insertion indicators during drag reordering., **Zero Timestamp Acceleration & Drift Fix**: Hardened Gemini system instructions and timeline notices to strictly lock segment timestamps to the physical audio playhead speed. Prevents timestamps from accelerating or running ahead of actual spoken audio over long recordings., **Strict Anti 1-Word 1-Space Prompting**: Added explicit prompt constraints and refined segment boundary joining for Khmer and Thai continuous scripts, preventing Gemini from injecting artificial spaces after every single word., **Combined Audio Player Playback Safeguard**: Disabled combined audio player triggers prior to completing transcription or while AI transcription is processing. Prevents playing untranscribed audio clips and avoids audio/transcript playback desynchronization., **Sentence Card Preservation for Continuous Scripts**: Fixed segment post-processing so continuous script languages without sentence-ending periods (such as Thai and Khmer) are not erroneously merged into single giant paragraph cards per file.
